design_description: A bold green, white and black jersey built around a strong repeating zigzag/chevron pattern. The main body alternates bright green and white in oversized vertical zigzags, creating a highly energetic graphic. The sleeves reverse the contrast with black-and-white chevrons, clearly separating them from the body while maintaining the same visual language. Small black details around the collar reinforce the contrast. The back continues the full green-and-white pattern, with a large black player name and number for maximum visibility. Overall, it's a simple but very striking geometric design, driven almost entirely by the oversized chevron motif.
